snippet.description:
Nach dem frühen Ausscheiden Deutschlands bei der Fußball-WM will der Deutsche Fußball-Bund offenbar eine schnelle Lösung rund um Trainer Nagelsmann. Bei einem Gipfel-Treffen in Frankfurt am Main soll ihm die DFB-Spitze einen Rücktritt nahegelegt haben. Nagelsmann hat sich Medienberichten zufolge Bedenkzeit erbeten. 

Heiko Neumann ordnet die Lage in Frankfurt ein.

snippet.title: How to succeed reselling 🤷🏻‍♂️ #reselling #fashion #vinted #reseller
snippet.description:
🚨 Adapt or get left behind. That’s the reality in business.

The way people buy and sell has changed massively over the years — especially in the vintage & second-hand world. What once sold only in physical shops now moves through eBay, Vinted, Instagram, TikTok, live streams, and online communities every single day.

If you’re running a business the same way you did 5 years ago, you’re already behind. The businesses that survive are the ones willing to evolve, learn new platforms, test new strategies, and meet customers where they are.

In vintage fashion & second-hand reselling, we’ve seen the shift firsthand:
🛍️ From local shops
📦 To eBay flipping
📱 To Vinted & Depop
🎥 To live stream selling & social commerce

The market changes. Customer behaviour changes. Algorithms change. Winning businesses adapt.

Whether you’re a reseller, vintage clothing seller, entrepreneur, or small business owner — being open to change is one of the biggest skills you can develop.

💡 Growth comes from adapting, not staying comfortable.
